overlap_rule: Do not sum overlapping tests, corrected stages or follow-up rechecks. Each original result/source scope remains authoritative.

actual_v1.scope: Exact deployed V1 runtime plus synthetic ERC721 fixture. Attempts1/2 retain native solc stack-overflow failures. Bounded test-only runtime literals fixed the host failure without compiler/financial changes.

actual_popl_mint.scope: Real NFT/Vault/VaultCanonical/Budget/Policy/helper/royalty graph with explicit MockAccess and MockVRF. No full handoff, real provider or LP venue claim.

quota_model.scope: Getter-verified synthetic helper historical counts and mocked NFT count. Does not claim minting1000 actual NFTs or proving historical ownership/backing.

nft_canonical.scope: Original failed/corrected NFT codec stages are retained. Domain-level tests are distinct from the whole-coordinator run.

whole_handoff.scope: Final full local coordinator test with explicit mocks and documented per-transaction gas/memory/transient-state test harness. Earlier failed attempts and original diagnostic traces are retained. Original8-row/12M operating budget is unchanged; test harness gas resets are not target qualification.

existing_regressions.scope: Only existing NFTMetadata,RandomnessRequestSettings,RoyaltyLaunchWindow paths; default fuzz1000. Copied owned artifacts reused; originals unchanged. Source before/during/after manifests included. No unchanged LP suite.

license_provenance: Original verified source/dependency license headers are preserved. Top-level SeaDrop is SPDXMIT; captured Solmate dependency headers include AGPL-3.0-only. No MIT-only dependency-closure claim.
global_boundaries: No public transaction, wallet key, deployment or service change.
Mock feed/VRF/authority/dependency behavior is not provider qualification.
Engineering gas is not target-chain acceptance.
OpenSea custom onboarding, exact platform recipient/terms and independent approval remain separate.
